verified_facts.text: The resort sits on Naka Yai Island, just off the Phuket coast, and no other resort is located on the island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Only Resort Located on Naka Yai Island

verified_facts.text: The resort is reached by speedboat alone, a short journey of about five minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort is accessible only by a short 5-minute speedboat journey

verified_facts.text: Guests check in at the resort's Lobby Lounge at Ao Por Grand Marina, about a 30-minute drive from Phuket International Airport, before the speedboat ride.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 30-minute drive from Phuket International Airport will lead you to our Lobby Lounge at Ao Por Grand Marina. Start with a luxurious check-in and take a moment to relax before our 5-minute speedboat ride

verified_facts.text: Sea View 1 Bedroom Villas have a private pool, a covered sala and a daybed in a spacious outdoor area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Comprising a private pool, covered sala, and daybed, it is an ideal place to relax with a book and refreshments from the mini bar.

verified_facts.text: Beachfront Villas sit steps from the beach, and Beachfront Pool Villas add a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated mere steps from the island’s ivory beaches and sparkling sea, Beachfront Villas offer an unrivaled stay. Beachfront Pool Villas offer the additional benefit of a private pool.

verified_facts.text: All beachfront villas include a wooden bed crowned with a white canopy.
verified_facts.excerpt: All our beachfront villas in Phuket include an opulent wooden bed crowned with a white canopy

verified_facts.text: The gated Royal Horizon Pool Villa is a two-bedroom oceanfront hilltop villa with pool access, a plunge pool and a pool cabana, suited to larger families and private wedding receptions.
verified_facts.excerpt: our gated 1,600-square-meter Royal Horizon Pool Villa features 2 bedroom Villa, Oceanfront, pool access, plunge pool, pool cabana enchants at every turn, ideal for larger families, and secluded wedding reception and exclusive groups.

verified_facts.text: Every villa category comes with a dedicated Curator, a personal butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: A refined experience crafted for guests of all villa categories, each complemented by dedicated butler service.

verified_facts.text: Spa Naka by HARNN is guided by HARNN's traditional Thai philosophy and offers massages, couples massages, facials, body scrubs, a steam room and therapy baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by nature and guided by HARNN’s traditional Thai philosophy, our luxury spa invites you to renew strength, balance, and inner well-being.

verified_facts.text: The freshwater infinity pool looks out over the ocean and Phang Nga Bay, with poolside food and drink service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seamlessly blending with the incandescent ocean and Phang Nga Bay views, our freshwater pool invites guests to arrive at a place of unrivaled repose. Poolside food and beverage service add to the leisurely ambiance

verified_facts.text: Three private cabanas sit beside the Infinity Pool, steps from the private beach, with food and drinks from Rum Chapel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in one of our three private cabanas, located beside the Infinity Pool and just steps from the private beach. Enjoy effortless pool or beach days with food and drinks available from Rum Chapel.

verified_facts.text: Aiyara, the signature restaurant, serves reimagined Royal Thai cuisine in an open-air setting by the sea, featuring local ingredients such as Naka Island mud crab and Southern herbs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reimagined Royal Thai flavors highlight local treasures such as Naka Island mud crab and Southern herbs

verified_facts.text: Zbar is a beachfront bar with daybeds overlooking the Andaman Sea, serving cocktails and juices made from local fruits and herbs with Asian tapas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embrace laid-back island life at Zbar, a beachfront bar in Phuket featuring daybeds overlooking the dramatic Andaman Sea.

verified_facts.text: A daily Sunset Ceremony is held at Zbar, with a narration of Naka Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embrace the vibrancy of this special evening with the narration of Naka Island, come together with your loved ones and create unforgettable memories.

verified_facts.text: Guided kayaking tours explore the island's mangrove forests as part of the resort's environmental initiatives.
verified_facts.excerpt: We also offer guided kayaking tours through the mangrove forests of Naka Island as part of our environmental initiatives.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a Mangrove Planting Program on Naka Yai Island, planting mangrove saplings to help protect the coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us in safeguarding the coastline and supporting the delicate ecosystem by planting mangrove saplings.

verified_facts.text: Activities include Muay Thai lessons, Thai cooking classes, Hobie Cat sailing, paddle boarding, kayaking and birdwatching.
verified_facts.excerpt: With activities ranging from Muay Thai lessons and Thai cooking classes to Hobie Cat sailing, paddle boarding, kayaking, and birdwatching

verified_facts.text: Bike tours explore the island's villages and jungle, with stops at fishing villages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the villages and jungle of Naka Island with a bike tour. This low-to medium-intensity outing includes stops at quaint fishing villages and stunning tropical scenery.

verified_facts.text: Naka Kids Club offers indoor crafts and outdoor adventures, including beach hermit crab discoveries, and babysitting is available.
verified_facts.excerpt: daily activities like beach hermit crab discoveries and crafts keep imaginations alive. Babysitting services are offered

verified_facts.text: Floating breakfast can be served in a private pool villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Awaken to a floating breakfast in your private pool villa, where luxury meets tranquility.

verified_facts.text: Boat trips run to the Phi Phi Islands, and guests can kayak around James Bond Island in Phang Nga Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: For a day of adventure, take a boat trip to the iconic Phi Phi Islands or kayak around the James Bond Island in Phang Nga Bay

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: The bird watching activity introduces guests to more than 50 species around the island.
verified_facts.excerpt: be introduced to more than 50 species of our feathered friends around the island and learn about conservation practices.
